title: The MM2 normalization batch one (census 940)

banner.title: The MM2 normalization batch one - 83 of 332 defs rewritten to the full-field 57-key emission
banner.provenance: The MM2 normalization - the per-book schema pass continued (the R879 normalizer doctrine, R1009-R1014 the MM1 arc, R1016 the OA book close): every sparse MM2 def rewritten to the full-field 57-key emission of the landed tools/normalize_registry.py - string sentinels n/a, integer sentinels -1, saveAsBonus riding the loader zero default (the R155 contract) - byte-exact against the normalizer output, the canonical FIELD_ORDER honored. The MM2 defs were promoted to the registry post-normalizer, so this batch is ALL INSERT SITES - 586 anchored inserts (2236 inserted lines), zero whole-line reorders, zero move encodings; the fields are already in canonical order, only sparse. No normalizer repairs ride this round. Eight audited keys in this batch (amaimon, azer, fire_bat, cambion, camptosaurus, chaggrin, crysmal, dao) - every constraint reads a key the def already carries; no audit touches a sentinel-emitted key. The MM2 census after this round: 332 defs, 83 canonical, 249 remaining. THE QUEUE: the MM2 batches two through four follow, then FF 185, WSG+MOP 23, DRG 5, the deity seam.

audit_comment: THE MM2 NORMALIZATION - the per-book schema pass continued: 83 of 332 defs rewritten to the full-field 57-key emission, byte-exact against the landed normalize_registry.py; all insert sites, no reorder sites.
prev_record: in the seed before the last
